items.name: netbox-mcp-server
items.description: netbox-mcp-server is a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for NetBox published by NetBoxLabs, enabling LLM clients to query NetBox network data through natural language.

items.name: MCPyATS
items.description: MCPyATS is a Python framework combining the Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, and Cisco pyATS for natural-language driven network task automation using an agentic AI architecture.
